interactive_rss.method: Five alternating baseline/candidate PTY observations per executable with a 24x100 controlling terminal, --paging=always, the 265220-byte corpus, wait for the first displayed frame then send q; resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss is bytes on macOS. The included pty_script is invoked in a fresh Python process for each observation. This is early-exit interactive memory, not a full traversal.
interactive_rss.qualification: All captured frame hashes match. These observations do not establish memory reduction.
interactive_rss.pty_script:
import fcntl, hashlib, os, pty, resource, select, signal, struct, subprocess, sys, termios, time
program, corpus = sys.argv[1:]
master, slave = pty.openpty()
fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack('HHHH', 24, 100, 0, 0))
def setup():
    os.setsid()
    fcntl.ioctl(0 if os.path.basename(program) == 'scrl' else 1, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
source = open(corpus, 'rb') if os.path.basename(program) == 'diff-pretty' else slave
args = [program, '--paging=always'] + ([] if os.path.basename(program) == 'diff-pretty' else [corpus])
p = subprocess.Popen(args, stdin=source, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, preexec_fn=setup, close_fds=True)
os.close(slave)
buf = bytearray()
deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
sent = False
while time.monotonic() < deadline and p.poll() is None:
    ready, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], .1)
    if ready:
        try: data = os.read(master, 65536)
        except OSError: break
        buf.extend(data)
        if not sent and b'\x1b[' in buf and len(buf) > 100:
            os.write(master, b'q')
            sent = True
try: code = p.wait(timeout=2)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    p.kill(); p.wait(); code = 124
while select.select([master], [], [], 0)[0]:
    try:
        data = os.read(master, 65536)
        if not data: break
        buf.extend(data)
    except OSError: break
print('exit=%s sent_q=%s bytes=%s sha256=%s rss=%s' % (code, sent, len(buf), hashlib.sha256(buf).hexdigest(), resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss))
sys.exit(0 if code == 0 and sent else 1)

reproduction.pair_script:
#!/bin/zsh
set -u
root="$PWD"
for package in diff-pretty scrl; do
  for iteration in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    for side in base candidate; do
      if [ "$side" = base ]; then tree="$root/../ds-perf-base"; else tree="$root"; fi
      label="${package}-${iteration}-${side}"
      cd "$tree" || exit 1
      uptime > "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.load"
      sysctl -n hw.ncpu >> "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.load"
      perf-gate-ready > "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.pre" 2>&1
      pre=$?
      if [ "$pre" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s pre=%s\n' "$label" "$pre"; exit 50; fi
      env CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PWD/.work/perf-abort-target" TMPDIR="$PWD/.work/tmp" RUSTC_WRAPPER=kache CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_APPLE_DARWIN_LINKER=clang RUSTFLAGS='-Zlocation-detail=none -Zunstable-options -Cpanic=immediate-abort -Clink-arg=-Wl,-dead_strip_dylibs' cpu-guard --cores 2 -- rustybench baseline --baseline "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.json" --warmup 1 --runs 1 --sample-count 5 --sample-size 10 -- cargo bench -p "$package" --bench bench --profile dist -Z build-std=std -Z build-std-features= -Z panic-abort-tests --target aarch64-apple-darwin > "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.log" 2>&1
      run=$?
      perf-gate-ready -1 > "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.post" 2>&1
      post=$?
      printf '%s pre=%s run=%s post=%s\n' "$label" "$pre" "$run" "$post"
      if [ "$post" -ne 0 ]; then exit 51; fi
      if [ "$run" -ne 0 ]; then exit 52; fi
    done
  done
done
reproduction.invocation: From candidate checkout: zsh .work/tmp/run-pairs.sh. Script expects sibling ds-perf-base at the pinned baseline and writes only ignored .work/tmp receipts; build each package first with its --no-run command under the stated environment. Recreate the script from pair_script.

Build binaries using binary_builds commands; create input with cat fixtures/*.patch > .work/tmp/perf-corpus.patch.
